subject.title: WhatsApp session stalls on long model_call: incomplete turn with payloads=0, reply never delivered

question: Should this concrete WhatsApp/Codex incident stay open until a narrow WhatsApp final-fallback fix lands, or be folded into the broader durable-delivery contract after reconciling the open Codex lane PR?
rationale: Current source still drops final WhatsApp fallback payloads, but related run-lifecycle work has landed and the remaining open PR covers only one slice, so automation should not choose the issue/PR sequencing for maintainers.

options.title: Keep Open And Reconcile Slices
options.body: Keep this issue open, decide whether https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/94833 is still needed after https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/102160, and land or recreate the WhatsApp final-fallback fix.

options.title: Fold Into Durable Delivery Contract
options.body: Close this only after a maintainer records that https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/87561 fully owns the remaining WhatsApp final-fallback delivery proof and preserves this issue's production evidence.

options.title: Reopen A Narrow WhatsApp Patch
options.body: Sponsor a replacement for the closed unmerged WhatsApp PR focused only on final isError delivery and live/redacted transport proof.

recommendation.title: Keep Open And Reconcile Slices
recommendation.body: Keep this issue open, decide whether https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/94833 is still needed after https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/102160, and land or recreate the WhatsApp final-fallback fix.

likelyOwner.reason: osolmaz is assigned here and authored the broader durable final fallback contract that would own any fold-in decision.
